1. The charges for Covered Treatments of an Accidental Injury are Incurred within the Benefit Period shown on the
3. The total charges for the medical event or treatment rendered are not in excess of the Maximum Allowable Amount
shown above. Any portion of such charges in excess of the Maximum Allowable Amount will not be considered when
Accidental Dismemberment Benefit Description:
We will pay an Accidental Dismemberment Benefit if all of the following requirements are met:
1. The Accident and Accidental Dismemberment occur while the Accidental Dismemberment Benefit provision is in force.
2. The Accidental Dismemberment occurs within 90 days of the date the Accident occurred.
The Accidental Dismemberment Benefit will not be paid if the severed body part is subsequently re-attached. The Accidental
Dismemberment Benefit payable for each type of dismemberment is shown on the Benefit Schedule. Only Accidental
Dismemberments shown on the Benefit Schedule are eligible for benefits under this provision. Accidental Dismemberment
Benefits are subject to the Accidental Death and Dismemberment Maximum Benefit Limitation.
Accidental Death Benefit Description:
If the Covered Person dies as a direct result of the Accident, We will pay the corresponding Accidental Death Benefit to the
Beneficiary if all of the following requirements are met:
2. The proof shows that death resulted directly from bodily Accidental Injury caused solely as a result of an Accident and
3. Accidental Death occurred within the first 90 days after the Accident , except that, in cases when at the end of the 90
4. Accidental Death occurred prior to the date the Covered Person attains age 75.
We will not pay any Accidental Death Benefits for death occurring between the date the coverage lapses and the date
Accidental Death Benefits are subject to the Accidental Death and Dismemberment Maximum Benefit Limitation shown on the
